stepExpects.reference: Bring in the images this sprite is drawn from. Nothing is painted here.
stepExpects.palette: Settle every colour the sprite may use, grouped into ramps. Shadows move cool and lose chroma; lights move warm.
stepExpects.silhouette: One filled shape in one slot. Shape is what a viewer resolves first, and the hardest thing to change later.
stepExpects.flats: Each material's base slot, unshaded. The material map decides the colour areas, so it is settled before anything is shaded.
stepExpects.shadow: The shadow bands, before any light. The shadow shape is the description of the form; shading inward from the edge instead is pillow shading.
stepExpects.light: The lit planes, placed against a form the shadow has already described.
stepExpects.outline: The outline, now that the fills it borders exist. Its colour comes from the fill beside it and never from flat black.
stepExpects.detail: Interior features, folds and face, on a form that is already resolved.
stepExpects.accent: The rim light and the speculars: the highest-contrast pixels on the sprite, and the ones on a budget.
stepExpects.cleanup: Anti-alias the interior edges and remove strays. A polish pass over finished edges, so it is done once.
stepExpects.variation: Fork the sprite with a new palette. Not one pixel moves, so the value structure cannot drift.

step.title: Step
step.noReport: The gates have not been run on this sprite yet.
step.noChecks: This step measures nothing, so there is nothing to verify.
